title: When the Bakery Falls
author: Ada Underhill
blurb: Oscar Underhill, a vineyard owner who inherited debts instead of grapes, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. Then the person behind a decade of letters moves in next door — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must let someone stay after the last train leaves before the festival ends.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
